description: DiligenceOps: submit a benchmark or performance claim and the source text it cites. The signed report lists every figure in the claim and whether the source states it (same value and unit, with time, size and rate conversions, or a source figure that rounds to it), quotes the source sentence, and names each figure the source does not support beside the source figures in the same unit. POST /api/benchmark-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

claim.description: The benchmark or performance claim, for example "3x faster than v1 with 40% lower p99 latency (220 ms)".

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

source.description: The source text the claim cites, up to 256 KB.

source_label.description: Optional name of the cited source, recorded in the report.

name: wever_benchmark-evidence-check
title: Benchmark evidence check
